title: Calpha: Toward Native Biomolecular Intelligence in a General-Purpose Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.20986v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Biomolecular foundation models predict the structures of proteins and their complexes accurately, and large language models (LLMs) reason in natural language, but the two remain separate: the abilities of the former are not part of a general-purpose LLM, and the reasoning of the latter does not enter a structure prediction. Calpha aims at one general model that folds proteins and complexes, understands protein sequence and structure, and lets its language reasoning influence the structures it predicts. This report covers the first step, in which an LLM outputs single-chain protein structures. Qwen3.5-9B reads a sequence enriched with ESM2 residue features. It can respond in text or emit a token that invokes a pretrained SimpleFold structure head, which receives information about the protein only through Qwen's residue states. Under a fixed folding request, the head achieves mean TM-scores of 0.808 on the FoldBench-334 development set,

translated_title: Calpha：迈向通用语言模型中的原生生物分子智能
translated_abstract: 生物分子基础模型能够准确预测蛋白质及其复合物的结构，而大型语言模型（LLM）能够以自然语言进行推理，但二者至今仍然相互分离：前者的能力并非通用LLM的组成部分，而后者的推理也无法进入结构预测过程。Calpha旨在构建一个通用模型，它既能折叠蛋白质及其复合物、理解蛋白质序列与结构，又能让语言推理影响其预测出的结构。本报告涵盖了第一步工作，即由一个LLM输出单链蛋白质结构。Qwen3.5-9B读取经ESM2残基特征增强的蛋白质序列，它既可以用文本进行回应，也可以发出一个特殊token来调用预训练的SimpleFold结构头，而该结构头只能通过Qwen的残基状态获取蛋白质相关信息。在固定的折叠请求下，该结构头在FoldBench-334开发集上取得了0.808的平均TM分数。
tldr: Calpha首次将蛋白质折叠能力原生集成进通用大语言模型Qwen3.5-9B，通过语言模型残基状态驱动SimpleFold结构头，实现语言推理与蛋白质结构预测的统一，单链折叠在FoldBench-334上达到0.808的平均TM分数。
en_tdlr: Calpha natively integrates protein folding into a general-purpose LLM (Qwen3.5-9B), where a SimpleFold structure head conditioned solely on the LLM's residue states enables language reasoning to drive single-chain structure prediction, achieving a mean TM-score of 0.808 on FoldBench-334.
